title: KID TRAVIS presents a wonderful new track "LOSE MY WAY"
htmlContent:
Singer and Songwriter KID TRAVIS presents a new single called "LOSE MY WAY," a smooth melodic style and unique lyrics about the special people in his life. The production sets the ultimate tone with a smooth touch to the music, that genre bends well to make one sound that makes you slow down to take in the feel of the music.

KID TRAVIS's LOSE MY WAY is the perfect record to show how powerful music can be when the artist puts their heart and soul into it. Keep in Touch with KID TRAVIS.
